props.label: About Us
props.heading: Run by people who own animals too
props.body:
We opened on Ramdaspeth Main Road because we kept driving across the city for a decent bag of food, and decided somebody ought to just stock it properly.

Everything on our shelves is something we would give our own animals. We do not stock the cheap filler food that keeps a dog alive and slowly ruins its coat, and we will tell you honestly when the expensive bag is not worth the difference for your pet.

Grooming and veterinary consultation both happen in store, so a nervous dog does not have to be driven to a third place on the same day. Our groomers work by appointment so there is no waiting room full of barking.

If you have just brought a puppy or kitten home and have no idea where to start, come in and ask. We will talk you through food, vaccination timing and what you actually need versus what the internet says you need.

items.title: Adult Dog Food
items.desc: Complete dry food for adult dogs, with real meat as the first ingredient and no artificial colouring. The bag most of our regulars come back for.
items.body:
A complete dry food for adult dogs, meaning it has everything they need without a supplement on the side.

Meat is the first ingredient rather than a cereal, which is the single thing worth checking on any bag you pick up. No artificial colouring — the dye in cheaper food is there for the human buying it, not the dog eating it.

Chicken and rice suits most dogs and is the easiest on a sensitive stomach. Lamb is the one to try if your dog has been itchy or has reacted to chicken before. The vegetarian option is a genuine complete food, not a compromise, for households that do not keep meat.

If you are switching from another brand, mix it in over about a week rather than changing overnight. Sudden switches upset stomachs and then people blame the new food.

productInfo.label: Switching
productInfo.value: Mix in gradually over a week

items.title: Cat Food
items.desc: Complete food for adult cats in dry and wet varieties, with taurine for heart and eye health.
items.body:
Complete food for adult cats, formulated with added taurine — cats cannot make enough of it themselves and a shortage causes heart and eye problems over time. Every reputable cat food includes it; it is worth checking the ones that do not.

Dry food is more economical and better for teeth. Wet food carries far more moisture, which matters because cats have a weak thirst drive and a lot of urinary trouble traces back to chronic mild dehydration. Many owners here do dry in the morning and wet in the evening.

Fish is the flavour most cats go for. Chicken is the one to try if your cat has a sensitive stomach.

If your cat is over seven, ask us about the senior formulation instead.

items.title: Handmade Cat Toys
items.desc: Crochet toys made locally, stuffed with catnip. No glued-on eyes or plastic parts to come loose.
items.body:
Crochet toys made by a small group of women here in Nagpur, filled with catnip.

We stock these instead of the imported plastic ones because there is nothing on them to come loose. No glued eyes, no squeaker to be chewed out and swallowed, no hard plastic to crack into sharp pieces. Just yarn and stuffing, which is far less interesting to an emergency vet.

The catnip fades after a few weeks of play. Put the toy in a sealed bag with a pinch of fresh catnip for a day and it comes back.

The set of three is the sensible buy — cats lose toys under furniture at a remarkable rate.

productInfo.label: Safety
productInfo.value: No glued eyes or plastic parts

productInfo.label: Refreshing
productInfo.value: Seal with fresh catnip for a day

items.title: Travel Pet Carrier
items.desc: A padded carrier with mesh panels on three sides, a seatbelt strap and a base board that stops it sagging.
items.body:
A soft-sided carrier with mesh on three sides, which matters more than it sounds — an animal that can see out is dramatically calmer than one in a box.

There is a rigid board in the base so the floor does not sag under the animal's weight, and a strap that runs through a car seatbelt so the carrier does not slide across the seat on a corner.

Size by weight, not by how big the animal looks. Small suits up to about 5 kg, medium to 9 kg, large to 15 kg. The animal should be able to stand up and turn around; if it cannot, size up.

If you are flying, check your airline's exact cabin dimensions before buying — they differ, and we cannot take back a carrier that has been used.

productInfo.label: Mesh
productInfo.value: Three sides, for airflow and calm

items.title: Collar & Leash Set
items.desc: A padded collar and matching leash in nylon webbing, with a welded D-ring rather than a bent one.
items.body:
A padded collar and matching leash in nylon webbing.

The D-ring is welded closed rather than bent into shape. This is the part that fails on cheap collars — a bent ring pulls open under a hard lunge, usually next to a road, which is exactly when it matters.

The padding sits against the neck so the webbing does not rub a bald patch on a dog that pulls. Two fingers should fit between the collar and the neck; tighter and it chafes, looser and a determined dog backs out of it.

A harness is the better choice for a dog that pulls hard or has a short muzzle — ask us and we will fit one properly rather than selling you this.

productInfo.label: Note
productInfo.value: Ask about a harness for hard pullers

items.title: Home Grooming Kit
items.desc: Clippers, a slicker brush, nail clippers with a guard and a de-shedding comb, in a case.
items.body:
Clippers, slicker brush, nail clippers with a guard, de-shedding comb and scissors, in a case that keeps them together.

The nail clippers have a quick guard on them, which is the part worth paying for. Cutting into the quick hurts, bleeds a lot, and teaches an animal to fight you every time the clippers come out afterwards.

The basic kit covers a short-coated dog or a cat. The pro kit adds a quieter clipper with adjustable blade lengths, which is what you need for a double coat — a Golden, a Husky, a Pomeranian — where a standard clipper stalls and pulls.

Brushing is the bit that actually matters. Ten minutes twice a week on a long coat prevents the mats that otherwise have to be shaved out.

items.title: Aquarium Starter Kit
items.desc: Tank, filter, light and heater together, sized so a first fishkeeper is not fighting the water chemistry.
items.body:
Tank, filter, LED light and heater in one box, so nothing is missing on the day you set it up.

Start bigger than feels sensible. A 20-litre tank is far harder to keep alive than a 55-litre one, because a small volume of water swings in temperature and chemistry fast and gives you no time to react. Most first tanks fail for this reason and the owner concludes they are bad at fishkeeping.

Set it up and run it empty for a week before you buy any fish. The filter needs that time to grow the bacteria that process waste. Adding fish on day one is the other reason first tanks fail.

Bring us a sample of your water when you come for fish and we will test it for free.

productInfo.label: Before fish
productInfo.value: Run empty for a week to cycle

items.title: Interactive Puzzle Feeder
items.desc: A feeder that makes the food take twenty minutes instead of ninety seconds — for boredom, and for dogs that gulp.
items.body:
A feeder with compartments and sliders the animal has to work out to reach the food.

Two reasons to buy one. First, a dog that inhales its dinner in ninety seconds swallows a lot of air with it, which causes bloating and, in deep-chested breeds, something considerably worse. Slowing the meal down helps.

Second, boredom. Most destructive behaviour at home is an under-stimulated animal with nothing to do. Making dinner into a twenty-minute problem to solve does more for that than another walk.

Start on the easy level even if you think your pet is clever. An animal that cannot solve it gives up and walks away, and then the feeder sits in a cupboard.

items.q: Do you deliver, and how much is it?
items.a: Yes, across Nagpur. Free on orders over ₹799, otherwise ₹60. Heavy bags of food are carried to your door rather than left at the gate. Same-day delivery if you order before 4 PM.

items.q: Can I return food my pet will not eat?
items.a: An unopened bag, yes, within 15 days. An opened one we cannot resell, so no — but come and talk to us. Fussiness is often the switch being done too fast rather than the food itself, and we would rather fix that than lose you as a customer.

items.q: Do I need to book grooming?
items.a: Yes. We work by appointment specifically so animals are not stacked up waiting in a noisy room. Nail trims and ear cleaning are walk-in. Cat grooming is booked into cat-only slots with no dogs in earshot.

items.q: What do you need for boarding?
items.a: An up-to-date vaccination record, with no exceptions — it protects every other animal staying with us. Bring their own food if they are on something specific, and a blanket or toy that smells of home makes a real difference on the first night.

items.q: Is the vet here every day?
items.a: No, the consulting vet is in on scheduled days. Call or message before coming so you are not making the trip for nothing. Anything needing surgery, imaging or overnight care is referred to a full clinic, and we will tell you honestly when that is the case.
We do not sell dogs or cats. We stock fish and small pets, and for dogs and cats we will happily point you towards local rescues and shelters with animals looking for homes.

items.q: My puppy has just come home and I do not know where to start.
items.a: Come in and ask. That conversation is free and takes about fifteen minutes — food, vaccination timing, what to buy now and what can wait. It saves people a lot of money on things they do not need yet.

notes:
CONTENT MODEL: Built as a neighbourhood pet shop (Whiskers & Paws) on Ramdaspeth Main Road, Nagpur, with the shoppable catalogue as the centre and grooming/vet as the reason to buy locally rather than online. FOUR pages via the recipe-level 'pages' array: Home (/), Shop (/shop), Services (/services) and Contact (/contact). Header and footer link to those slugs; per-page 'content' overrides retitle the shared products/services sections.

VIDEO: The home hero plays a muted, looping, autoplay background video of a child with a dog at home (videoUrl — a direct MP4 from Pexels) under a 0.58 overlay, rendering light-on-dark. Chosen over the other landscape candidates because it is warm, indoor and affectionate; the rest were outdoor street dogs that read as strays rather than as a retail brand, and one was a cold grey landscape. The 'image' fallback is the wall-of-accessories shot so the shop reads even if the video is blocked.

PRODUCTS: Eight items exercising the full products manifest — nested attributes, per-combination variants with SKU, MRP and live stock, body copy, productInfo tables and slugs. Axes are what this trade actually sells on: Size x Flavour for food, Pack x Filling for toys, Size x Colour for carriers and collars, Kit x Coat for grooming, Tank Size x Water for aquariums, Level x Species for feeders. Last variant of each product is stock 0 to exercise the out-of-stock and disabled add-to-cart states.

PRICING at realistic Indian pet-retail levels for mid-2026 — food Rs 549 to Rs 5,699, toys Rs 219 to Rs 649, carriers Rs 1,899 to Rs 2,999, aquarium kits Rs 3,499 to Rs 13,499. Verify against the shop's own rate card before going live.

COPY ANGLE: pet owners are wary of being upsold on an animal they love, so the copy repeatedly does the opposite — a review about being talked out of the expensive food, an explicit 'we will say when the cheaper bag is fine' pillar, honest warnings that rimless-style fragility applies to cheap collar D-rings, that small aquariums are HARDER not easier, and that a harness beats this collar for a hard puller. That posture is the differentiator against an online seller and should survive any rewrite.

DELIBERATE: the FAQ states the shop does NOT sell dogs or cats and points at rescues instead. Live-animal sales are an ethical and increasingly a legal minefield in India, and a template that assumes a puppy counter would be a bad default to ship to every customer. A shop that does sell animals can add it themselves.

IMAGES: hosted Pexels CDN URLs, every one fetched and visually inspected — the deterministic filename pattern 404s for some ids, so never add one without checking. Replace with the shop's own photography before going live.

THEME: berry-paw, created for this recipe — deep berry violet with a warm apricot accent on cream, Nunito headings and Rubik body. Linked both ways via the theme's industries array. All colour pairs contrast-measured; see the theme file's notes before retuning.
